card.name: Last word of a term before a bracket
card.fires_on: The final word of a fixed medical phrase, such as rate in glomerular filtration rate or interval in confidence interval, right where an abbreviation or numbers in brackets or parentheses may follow.

modes.description: The word rate ending estimated glomerular filtration rate, before an eGFR abbreviation or a value.

modes.label: Statistics term
modes.description: The word interval ending 95% confidence interval, before a CI abbreviation or range.

modes.label: Other fixed phrases
modes.description: The last word of a set phrase that is often followed by a bracketed abbreviation or aside.

card.writes: It raises the chance of an opening square bracket next, and lowers the chance of an opening parenthesis.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a standard medical phrase where an abbreviation in brackets is likely to come next.
